text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I find myself as Sweep<n>Tosho's familiar on
her quest to learn<n>racing magic. In other words, I
became her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope. I don't wanna run on wood<n>chips today. Not
feeling it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If I don't wanna, I don't wanna! Nooo<n>meanssss
nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, the current situation is far<n>from ideal. At
this rate, getting Sweep<n>Tosho to make her official
debut<n>might prove to be a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her refusal to listen to me probably<n>comes from a
long history of<n>distrusting her teachers and
mentors.
choice_data_list: (If only I could get her to trust me a bit more...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That said, earning Sweep Tosho's<n>trust is far from
easy. The days spent<n>testing various methods to no
avail<n>start to take a toll on my sleep<n>schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I wait hours on end for her<n>to feel inclined
to train, and yet<n>another day—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! I don't wanna see another<n>track today!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So instead, I bring Sweep Tosho<n>somewhere new
for a change of<n>pace.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, "Limited-Edition Fresh<n>Honeyade"? Well... it
looks okay, I<n>guess.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, I'll drink it if you insist. But I<n>don't wanna
line up. Go buy it for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait! C'mon familiar, what're<n>you yawning
like that for?! It's bad<n>manners!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I earn myself another scolding for that<n>yawn before
heading to the back of<n>the line. Maybe this fatigue
is<n>catching up to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The line is impressively<n>long—probably because
they're<n>selling limited-edition drinks. Either<n>way, all I
have to do is wait it out...

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again—five drinks, one for<n>each of my
friends!

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
M-my apologies. Fresh Honeyade is<n>a
limited-edition product, so each<n>customer may only
purchase up to<n>two drinks at a time...

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I ain't here for yer excuses! The<n>customer's
always right! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Two high school Umamusume are<n>arguing with the
store employee! And<n>things are getting real tense...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's she—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You an idiot or something?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's clearly written right here, "Onlytwo drinks per person"! These hugeletters too small for you to read? Doyou even have eyes?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you idiots buy them all out,<n>there'll be no
more left for me! Try<n>using your head for once, will
you?!

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The hell's up with this brat?<n>And what's the
weird hat for?<n>Shaddup and get lost.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Weird hat? Grandma gave me thishat—it's proof that I'm a magical girl...And you called it WEIRD?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thaaat's it, I've had it with you!<n>Let's settle this
with a race! I'll show<n>you who should really shut
up!

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're on, brat!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I muster up all my courage and step<n>in between
them. It's too late to stop<n>this feud, but at least...
choice_data_list: At least, have the race somewhere safer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to calm down both sides, who<n>look like they're
about to sprint off at<n>any moment...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I manage to borrow the<n>track where
amateur runners hold<n>unofficial races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To prevent any unwanted fisticuffs, I<n>place myself
in between Sweep<n>Tosho and the other
Umamusume<n>before explaining the rules.
choice_data_list: W-well then, 1,400 meters on turf... Okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without bothering to respond, the two<n>head towards
the starting gate.<n>Before sending off Sweep Tosho,
I<n>steel myself and tell her...
choice_data_list: If anything happens, I'll jump in and stop them.
If anything happens, I'll jump in and stop them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even if it's in the middle of the<n>race? You
might get hurt real bad,<n>y'know? I don't—
choice_data_list:
So just relax, and go show them what you're
made of!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And then, the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...What was that all about? Making it<n>sound like I'd
definitely win if nothing<n>strange happens.)

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you're just a brat! A slow<n>one, too! Don't
mind me, just<n>passin' through!

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you who should really shut<n>up," was it?
Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Urghhh, I'd win this even without<n>your help!
There's no way I'm losing<n>to a pair of annoying
jerks like these<n>two!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I see it—the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (I... I gotta win! I'll leave those<n>dimwits in the dust!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because the strongest one here— is<n>meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Opponents
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no waaay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, did you see that just now?!<n>She had a crazy
burst of speed at the<n>end there!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! That was like so, super<n>hype!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Huh? I feel like... really good?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because I put those numbskulls<n>in their place?
No, it's not just that—)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the high schoolers<n>come and
apologize, and then I go<n>right to Sweep—her running
was a<n>sight to behold.
choice_data_list: It's like I said before, your running was magical.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that reminds me, the first time we<n>met they
also...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar? Aren't you wobbling a<n>little bit? You
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thunk.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wha—familiar?! Hey! Say something,<n>dummy!
Answer meee!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I realize there's no more need<n>to worry, my
pent-up fatigue hits me<n>all at once—and before I
know it, my<n>consciousness fades.
